iDyikan.title: IDyikan
iDyikan.desc: iDyikan is a government digital platform for farmers that enables efficient asset management, task planning, and request tracking. With a clear interface and structured data, it helps users manage agricultural processes effectively.

completedTasks.1: Designed and implemented a detailed task view in the “My Assets” section, including status tracking and staff information.
completedTasks.2: Developed request tables in the “My Requests” section with accurate data visualization and reliable backend integration.

agroDialog.title: AgroDialog
agroDialog.desc: A single-page event platform with participant registration and administrative management system.

completedTasks.1: Built an interactive landing page with section-based navigation and registration modal.
completedTasks.2: Developed admin panel with authentication, participant filtering, and management tools.
completedTasks.3: Implemented PDF report viewing and downloading functionality.
completedTasks.4: Applied SEO optimization for better visibility.

seedProducersCabinet.title: Seed Producers Cabinet
seedProducersCabinet.desc: A government digital platform for seed production enterprises enabling submission of subsidy applications, management of production data, and participation in the national seed distribution system.

completedTasks.1: Extracted seed producer functionality from a monolithic system and implemented it as an independent service.
completedTasks.2: Implemented authentication and role-based access with dedicated navigation and user flow separation.
completedTasks.3: Implemented full application lifecycle from submission to processing through an administrative panel.

agroPortal.title: AgroPortal
agroPortal.desc: AgroPortal is a government digital platform for farmers and agribusinesses, providing access to agricultural services such as crop production, livestock management, biological protection, and tariff quota systems.

completedTasks.1: Developed dynamic vertical timelines to visualize service workflows and process stages.
completedTasks.2: Implemented responsive interface ensuring usability across desktop and mobile devices.

seedProducersAdmin.title: Seed Producers Admin Panel
seedProducersAdmin.desc: Administrative system for managing seed producer applications and generating analytical reports.

completedTasks.1: Implemented generation, preview, and download of Excel and PDF reports.
completedTasks.2: Built reporting functionality for administrative decision-making workflows.

realMadrid.title: Real Madrid Fan Website
realMadrid.desc: A multi-page Real Madrid fan website built as a learning project using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

completedTasks.1: Developed interactive UI elements including sliders, modals, and iframe integrations.
completedTasks.2: Recreated trophy pages inspired by the official Real Madrid website.
completedTasks.3: Implemented player cards with Transfermarkt-style statistics.
completedTasks.4: Built JavaScript components including a Card Switcher, converter, and weather display service.
